LanguageData.BiB_BodySlotDesc: Which body texture a pawn shows. A look gene on the pawn comes first, then the default of its race, then the default for everyone. Automatic changes nothing: the game and your texture mods decide.
LanguageData.BiB_FaceSlotDesc: Which face pack a pawn shows when it has no face look gene and no gene that a face pack targets. A look gene comes first, then the default of its race, then the default for everyone. Automatic changes nothing. The list shows only the face packs that are loaded.
